description: This file defines an interface class IOmiProxy within the omi namespace, which provides methods for managing crypted bundles and handling error listeners. It serves as a wrapper around an omi_dbus_api, facilitating simpler method calls and signal registration/unregistration.

classes.name: IOmiProxy
classes.description: An interface class providing methods to mount/unmount crypted bundles and manage error listeners.

methods.name: mountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Mounts a crypted bundle given its ID and file paths, returning the bundle path on success.

methods.name: umountCryptedBundle
methods.description: Unmounts a crypted bundle identified by its ID.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an error listener callback and returns a listener ID.

methods.name: unregisterListener
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered error listener by its ID.
